bootstrap.note: A descriptive respondent-cluster bootstrap (seed 20260826, 10,000 replicates) was conceptually specified in the frozen protocol but its implementation was never completed in scripts/score_orchinik_final_validation.py before real validation data existed. It was not a decision criterion. Not implemented post-hoc, per standing governance against editing the scorer after seeing results.

fix_scope: Added a label-translation step (ARM_LABEL dict, item-key regex) immediately before the existing, unmodified score()/apply_frozen_estimator()/compute_gemma_grid() functions. No RMSE formula, comparator, diagnostic, sign convention, outcome range, or cell count was changed.

mapping_uniquely_predetermined_before_an.item_key_translation: regex P_(.+)_given_cons(\d+) -> \1_cons\2, verified as a clean one-to-one mapping across all 25 Orchinik focal items
mapping_uniquely_predetermined_before_an.note: the mapping and the human-surface's own column-naming convention were both committed 2026-08-26, four days before the Gemma batch was even created (2026-08-30) -- the correction could not have been influenced by, or chosen in light of, any Orchinik or Gemma numeric value
mapping_uniquely_predetermined_before_an.source: outputs/domain_validation/frozen_domain_validation_protocol.json's own condition_label_mapping, established by reading the actual Qualtrics instrument text (Bovitz_qualtrics.docx) -- 'skill' discusses the history of climate science, 'trust' discusses institutional bias-safeguards -- never inferred from variable names or any numeric value

motivation: The first real run of the already-frozen scripts/score_orchinik_final_validation.py against the retrieved Gemma batch raised a KeyError before computing any metric: the human ATE surface (outputs/domain_validation/orchinik_human_ate_surface.json) labels arms as the paper's published names ('History'/'Institutions') and items as 'P_<belief>_given_cons<level>', while the Gemma-side manifest (built independently) uses the raw Bovitz condition values ('skill'/'trust') and bare item keys ('<belief>_cons<level>'). The scorer's human-surface loader needed a label translation layer to join the two, which it lacked.
